# FEAT-P1-09 exit criterion: the board-present beacon, CAPTURED OFF THE WIRE
# 2026-08-05, whole frames including the 14-byte Ethernet header.
#
# Source: ti64dink --live 12 --raw  (Npcap, unelevated), EtherType 0x88B5,
#         Pi 5 / BCM2712 netbooted, measure fixture, beacon seq 5964-5975.
# Format: <seq> <hex of the whole frame>
#
# The header is included deliberately. The destination MAC, source MAC and
# EtherType are the first fourteen bytes of gem::beacon_frame's output, so a
# comparison against a header-stripped payload would skip the three fields most
# likely to be wrong and pass while proving less than it claimed.
#
# The seq is recorded beside the bytes because it is the test's INPUT:
# beacon_frame(seq) is what gets compared. A test that read the sequence out of
# the frame it is checking would be comparing the frame to itself.
#
# Consumed by hal_arm64::gem's the_captured_beacon_is_byte_identical... test via
# include_str!, so this file is the single copy - the evidence and the fixture
# are the same bytes and cannot drift apart.
